sources.ref: Walkplay Android app 2.3.1 (com.ttgk.musicbox): its product catalog (data/catalogs/walkplay.json) lists 0x3302:0x51c0 "TT39510B01" under scheme 11; band count, filter types and Q and pre-gain limits as the app's editor gives them for that scheme

meta.notes:
Its recorded capture's product id is in devicePEQ's "SchemeNo11" group, whose settings apply under the device's own. Reported quirk, not corrected (D39): devicePEQ measured an EPZ TP13 placing bands about 2.25% below the frequency sent, with Q coming out lower toward high frequencies, and applies both to every SchemeNo11 device. Vendor apps send and show frequencies as they are, and so does this profile.
devicePEQ and Walkplay's app agree on 8 bands of peaking, low shelf, low pass and high pass filters for scheme 11. Its Q and pre-gain limits are those of Walkplay's web app, read back from a scheme 11 device: Q up to 10, as in devicePEQ, and a pre-gain of -16 to +6 dB in whole dB (devicePEQ: -128 to +127); not checked on this device.
devicePEQ's recorded capture of this device (walkplay_schemeno11_cs43131_hifi_audio_dsp.json) shows it holding a pre-gain of -10 dB, inside the web app's limits and outside the Android app's.
